name: lfp-skills
description: LFP ecosystem skills: oversight thinkers, core ops, and apex trading.

plugins.name: lfp-pm
plugins.description: Project Manager loader -- pm-live reads the canonical PM protocol from Notion at invocation time, so protocol edits land everywhere instantly without republishing. Fresh plugin on purpose: breaks the stale account-store cache that pinned the old pm.

plugins.name: lfp-thinkers
plugins.description: Oversight roundtable + router: critical, creative, logic, loop-breaker, ceo-planner, toolbox -- plus the Master Key creative process, the Intention Builder framework, extended-reasoning escalation and the five-step algorithm (question, delete, simplify, accelerate, automate -- in that order).

plugins.name: lfp-core
plugins.description: Core ops/build/meta/comms/QA skills for every working project.

plugins.name: lfp-apex
plugins.description: APEX live-money trading council and runtime health -- scope to trading projects only.

plugins.name: lfp-copy
plugins.description: Tone and copy skills for VMC Subastas commercial content -- outreach sequences, marketplace listings, page copy and source grounding.

plugins.name: lfp-design
plugins.description: Personal-project design-system enforcement (non-Subastop) -- e-ink brand tokens and component drift checks.

plugins.name: lfp-product
plugins.description: Subastop / VMC / CarMatch product line -- build, deploy, design-system and pre-ship gates. Scope to product projects only.

plugins.name: lfp-symbios
plugins.description: Symbios personal-OS layer -- session consciousness, capture and weekly continuity. Scope to Symbios and personal projects.

plugins.name: lfp-labs
plugins.description: Narrow single-project instruments -- voice architecture and production series artwork. Install only where the project lives.

plugins.name: lfp-roundtable
plugins.description: Mesa de thinkers: convenes lfp-thinkers seats (critical, logic, creative, loop-breaker) on ONE focus and lands their verdicts in the chat as a single message

plugins.name: lfp-apex-book
plugins.description: APEX book pane: positions, watchlist and market signals from the loop's snapshot.json, plus a status line. Read-only; run where apex-ultra lives (M1).

plugins.name: lfp-compass
plugins.description: Session compass: status line with the real machine, project, branch and context fill; at 70% context a band offers the continuity seed (CLAUDE.md auto-seed rule, enforced by the harness).

plugins.name: lfp-inbox
plugins.description: Mesh inbox in the console: the session's project inbox (agent-bridge, Notion) as a status line count, a toast on new mail, and an /inbox pane of unread messages to process or open.
